name: hyena
about: A spotted hyena: about 80 cm at the shoulder, a wide head with a blunt muzzle, round ears, a strong neck and forequarters, a short tail, a pale grey-brown coat with dark spots.
sources: Wikipedia, Spotted hyena (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spotted_hyena): "Adults measure 95–165.8 cm in body length, and have a shoulder height of 70–91.5 cm." "The tail is relatively short, being 300–350 mm long." "The spotted hyena has a strong and well-developed neck and forequarters, but relatively underdeveloped hindquarters." "The head is wide and flat with a blunt muzzle and broad rhinarium." The ears "are rounded rather than pointed". "The base colour generally is a pale greyish-brown or yellowish-grey."

The numbers of the shape and the coefficients of the shape space (0.4 of the coefficients of the bull: a heavy front): a guess from photos of iNaturalist (CC BY and CC0: observations 204761792, 103265782, 208631970). The coat has no spots: the coat has no region for spots.
The lengths of the fur (fur): a guess from photos of the animal, not a measurement.
